documentation.text: Onboarding and development plan cycle, one case per employee. Business data (personal details, goal descriptions, comments, notes, summaries, every plan round) lives in the devplan database; the case file holds what the sentries and the case history need (ids, status fields, decisions, goal titles). The task-models say which is which (x-store, x-case). The case is continuous: it has no completion milestone.

Only for new joiners: starts when the devplan backend creates the Onboarding case file item right after "+ New Employee" started the case. Cases started for an existing employee never get that item, so this stage never starts for them. Business data (personal details, IT request, checklist, assets) lives in the devplan database; the case file holds only flags.
Mail to HR (manager in cc) when the Onboarding stage ends (completes, or exits on the milestone Employee onboarded). At case level, because the stage itself has ended by then.
Continuous: runs for the life of the case.
Onboarding step 1. Owner: HR.
Mail to the new joiner (private e-mail): username and login link. Keycloak sends the set-password link separately.
Onboarding step 2. Owner: HR. Send to IT starts the Equipment request.
Mail to the IT admin that an equipment request is waiting.
Owner: IT admin. Issue equipment and set up accounts.
Owner: the new employee.
HR, once every mandatory checklist item is done. The backend sets Onboarding.mandatoryItemsDone first.
Ends onboarding. Development plan, Appraisal and Work cycle are then started by hand.

cafienne:implementation.name: EmployeeDetails

documentation.text: Onboarding step 1 - Employee details. Owner: HR. The "Details" object is business data: the devplan backend reads and writes it in its own database (x-store "employee"), never in the case file. On complete the backend creates the account and returns the Employee case item.

cafienne:implementation.name: ITRequest

documentation.text: Onboarding step 2 - IT & equipment request. Owner: HR. The request is business data in the devplan database (x-store "onboarding"); on complete the backend marks it sent and returns Onboarding.itRequestSent, which starts the IT admin's Equipment request.

cafienne:implementation.name: EquipmentRequest

documentation.text: Equipment request. Owner: IT admin. Shows HR's request (read-only, from the devplan database) and records the issued equipment in the asset register (x-store "assets"). Accounts are ticked on the IT checklist shown with the task.

cafienne:implementation.name: ConfirmEquipment

documentation.text: Confirm equipment received. Owner: the new employee. The issued assets come from the devplan database (x-store "assets", read-only here); the employee confirms receipt and can report anything missing (x-store "onboarding").
Repeating. Further development starts a new round inside this instance; Plan closed ends it, a new instance then waits for the next start.
Starts on Start development plan, or on Further development from the evaluation (a new round).
Exits on Plan performed, which also closes activities still open.
At this level, not inside Evaluate plan, which could auto-complete before it occurs.
Owner: Employee. Starts empty in every round (earlier rounds are in the devplan database). The manager may also fill it in (delegation).
Owner: Manager.
Owner: Employee.
Required, so the Plan stage cannot auto-complete before approval.

cafienne:implementation.name: DefinePlan

documentation.text: Define goals & plan. Owner: Employee. Starts empty in every round. The manager may also fill it in (delegation).

cafienne:implementation.name: ApprovePlan

documentation.text: Approve plan. Owner: Manager.

cafienne:implementation.name: RevisePlan

documentation.text: Revise plan. Owner: Employee.
Repeats ("continue") until a progress review marks the plan completed.
Owner: Employee. Adds a PROJECT activity to Activities.
Owner: Employee. Adds a TRAINING activity to Activities.
Owner: Employee. Adds a COACHING activity to Activities.
Starts Review progress now instead of waiting for the timer.
Owner: Manager. Starts on the 14-day timer or on Request early review, whichever comes first.

cafienne:implementation.name: ReviewProgress

documentation.text: Review progress. Owner: Manager. Starts on the 14-day timer or on Request early review, whichever comes first.

cafienne:implementation.name: ProjectsAssignments

documentation.text: Projects and assignments. Owner: Employee. Adds a PROJECT activity to Activities.

cafienne:implementation.name: TrainingLearning

documentation.text: Training and learning. Owner: Employee. Adds a TRAINING activity to Activities.

cafienne:implementation.name: CoachingMentoring

documentation.text: Coaching and mentoring. Owner: Employee. Adds a COACHING activity to Activities.
Owner: Employee. The employee rates their own progress first, goal by goal.
Owner: Manager. On complete the devplan backend closes the round in its database (earlier rounds live there).

cafienne:implementation.name: SelfAssessment

documentation.text: Self-assessment. Owner: Employee. The employee rates their own progress first, goal by goal.

cafienne:implementation.name: EvaluateResults

documentation.text: Evaluate & document results. Owner: Manager. Also copies the finished round (plan, approval, activities, reviews, self-assessment, evaluation) into PreviousRounds.

Welcome e-mail to the new joiner (private e-mail): username and where to log in. The password is set through the separate Keycloak e-mail. The engine posts the mail (recipients, subject, body below) to the devplan backend's mail relay, which sends it through the CaseFabric mailcatcher (http://localhost:1080).

cafienne:implementation.post-content:
{"to": "${employeeEmail}", "cc": "", "subject": "Welcome to CubeWorks, ${employeeName}", "html": "

Welcome to CubeWorks, ${employeeName}!

Your account has been created.

Username: ${username}
Log in at: http://localhost:8090

You will receive a separate e-mail with a link to set your password.

Your manager is ${managerName}. See you soon!

HR, CubeWorks

"}

documentation.text: Tells the IT admin that a new equipment request is waiting. The engine posts the mail (recipients, subject, body below) to the devplan backend's mail relay, which sends it through the CaseFabric mailcatcher (http://localhost:1080).

cafienne:implementation.post-content:
{"to": "${itEmail}", "cc": "", "subject": "New equipment request: ${employeeName}", "html": "

HR has sent the IT & equipment request for ${employeeName}.

Open My Tasks, Equipment request at http://localhost:8090 to issue the equipment and set up the accounts.

"}

documentation.text: Tells HR (and the manager, in cc) that the new joiner is onboarded. The engine posts the mail (recipients, subject, body below) to the devplan backend's mail relay, which sends it through the CaseFabric mailcatcher (http://localhost:1080).

cafienne:implementation.post-content:
{"to": "${hrEmail}", "cc": "${managerEmail}", "subject": "Onboarding complete: ${employeeName}", "html": "

${employeeName} is onboarded: every mandatory checklist item is done.

The development plan can now be started from the employee's case at http://localhost:8090.

"}
